note: Both sets share the same core claims and the same flaw: the sub-panel 'phase' claim binds '3 W' (the 3-wire designation) to phase, when the phase is 1~. Set B additionally extracts two correct facts from wiring schedule row 150 — the 2-1/2" conduit size and the #4G ground conductor size — which Set A omits. Those extra claims are supported by the row text '50 AL: 3#4/0, #4G., 2-1/2"C.' and are not contradicted anywhere on the page.
remarks: Shared error in both sets: 'SUB-PANEL PV | phase | 3 W' — the note reads '120/240V, 1~, 3W', i.e. 1-phase, 3-wire; 3W is the wire count, not the phase. The companion 'wire count | 3 W' claim is therefore a near-duplicate of the same notation. Entity 'NEMA 3R ENCLOSURE' in the main-breaker claim is vague (it is the sub-panel PV enclosure). Set B's quotes use ellipses within the row, which is acceptable here since the row text is intact in the text layer.
